agents.name: Blitz
agents.description: Launches a slow-moving rocket system that can be controlled like any other guided missile. When the missile confronts any object, it will slow down and jam nearby opponents. The rocket deals electrical damage as it moves and after coming into contact with an obstacle will detonate with a short delay, or it can be manually triggered.
agents.story: A tech expert who jams enemy electronics and strikes hard from a distance. A tech-obsessed rule follower, Blitz would rather solve problems with gadgets than people skills, he swears the future belongs to robots and remote warfare, mocking anyone stuck in the old ways. Maximum efficiency but little empathy; he's ruthlessly smart and honest to a fault, with a laser focus that gets results. Blitz claims he's too busy for friends or dating, truth is, he's terrible at both but would never admit it.

agents.name: Anansi
agents.description: Call in the assistance of an AC-130H Spectre gunship with a 40mm auto-cannon and a limited amount of ammunition for its precision 105mm gun
agents.story: A battlefield control specialist with a gunship providing backup fire. A tough cool kid from a Caribbean mix of cultures, Anansi grew up watching her seamstress mom work miracles with a needle and thread. Now she's working her own kind of miracles, making money for her family and avoiding bad company. She's all laughs and stories at the bar, but ask anything personal and she clams right up, that's none of your business. And don't gamble with her unless you want to lose your shirt.

agents.name: Ember
agents.description: Calls in a massive bomb strike after a delay. The bomb penetrates objects and detonates underground, creating a seismic blast wave that pushes enemies back.
agents.trait_description: Ensures safe movement through hazardous environments such as minefields and napalm, while also clearing through map physics objects and pushing players in or out of danger
agents.story: Defender, demolitionist, and the loudest answer to a fortified position. Where others would tippy-toe around hazards, Ember walks straight through. The Grand Slam Ultimate drops a heavy unguided bomb that penetrates terrain and detonates underground in a seismic blast. Juggernaut lets her shrug off minefields, napalm, wrecks, and most things that would stop anyone else.

agents.name: Kent
agents.description: Lock on to enemies in front of the vehicle for a missile strike. A short lock fires Hydra rockets, while an extended lock launches a homing Hellfire missile for much heavier damage.
agents.trait_description: Increases base reload time, but landing hits on enemies progressively reduces it.
agents.story: A versatile combatant equipped with a broad arsenal for any situation. Kent's adaptability makes him a constant threat on any battlefield. The Contracted Strike Ultimate sends Hydra rockets to immobilize on a short lock and a homing Hellfire on an extended one. Rising Tempo reduces reload time with every hit on an opponent.

agents.name: Hound
agents.description: Launches a TV missile that destroys marked lower-HP enemies and Traces others. Each destruction recharges the Ultimate for a short time.
agents.trait_description: Aiming at an enemy for a short time reveals their critical zones.
agents.story: Patient, methodical, and dangerous from anywhere with line of sight. Hound studies a target until he knows exactly where to put the next shot, then proceeds to put it right there. The Hunting Time Ultimate fires a TV-guided missile that executes low-HP targets and traces everyone nearby. Hunter's Eye exposes critical zones on enemies in sight for two seconds.

agents.name: Reaper
agents.description: Calls in an F-4 Phantom and places a napalm strike from an aerial targeting view.
agents.trait_description: Protects the vehicle from being destroyed with a single shot, provided it has sufficient HP.
agents.story: An offensive powerhouse who applies relentless psychological pressure to break enemy lines. His fast, aggressive style is both intimidating and effective. The Napalm in the Morning Ultimate hands you a targeting pod on a circling F-4 Phantom for an aerial-view fire strike. Relentless guarantees a single shot won't take him out, as long as his vehicle has the HP to survive it.

agents.name: Ray
agents.story: This agent is not documented. Statistics, details, and player feedback will be added once it's fully documented.

agents.name: Udarnik
agents.story: This agent is not documented. Statistics, details, and player feedback will be added once it's fully documented.

agents.name: Raketa
agents.description: Brings on a destructive rage, firing faster and surviving any hit with at least 1 HP.
agents.trait_description: Destroying enemy vehicles makes them drop Scrap Tokens, which can be picked up for temporary HP.
agents.story: A natural-born brawler and a brutal fighter. Raketa seeks out short-range collisions and loves to leave complete wreckage behind a point of contact. The Rampage Ultimate drops him into a faster-firing berserk state and guarantees survival at 1 HP, while Scavenger turns every ruined enemy into a Scrap Token he picks up for temporary hit points.

agents.name: Chopper
agents.description: Calls in a moving artillery strike with HE shells to clear positions and support allied pushes.
agents.trait_description: Provides damage mitigation and grants stackable extra protection while holding or contesting objectives.
agents.story: A veteran fighter who turns "we're getting pushed" into "we're holding this point until it's time to advance." Efficiently controls the pace of the fight from the front line. The Creeping Barrage Ultimate walks a wall of 155-mm and 203-mm HE shells across the map. The Stubborn Trait layers on damage mitigation that stacks up to five times when he's holding an objective.

agents.name: Twister
agents.description: Deploys an EMP bomb via drone. Pulses Slow enemies before the final detonation Jams and damages them.
agents.trait_description: Reloads faster while boosting, charges Boost Energy while drifting, and takes less fall damage.
agents.story: A skirmisher who reads the battlefield at a sprint. Twister leans on speed, momentum, and small autonomous weapons to keep the enemy at bay. The Lights Out Ultimate launches a drone-delivered EMP that pulses to slow enemies before detonating to jam and damage them. Daredevil lets him reload faster while boosting, charge Boost Energy off drifting, and take less fall damage.

agents.name: Fuzzer
agents.description: Calls in an aircraft and takes control of its targeting camera to lock on to an enemy vehicle. The aircraft points a laser that emits damaging pulses.
agents.trait_description: A decontamination system that removes all status effects from the vehicle.
agents.story: A gadget geek who sees the battlefield like a problem and his gear like the answer. Calm, opportunistic, almost impossible to lock down. The Strike Laser Ultimate puts a precision aircraft feed under Fuzzer's control to drop laser pulses on a target vehicle. NBC Protection periodically shrugs off whatever status effect just landed on him.

agents.name: Flair
agents.description: Deploy a proxy of your tank with identical parameters and modules, and switch between the two to throw enemies off scent.
agents.trait_description: Exceeding an Energy threshold recodes the vehicle's electronic signature, hiding it from enemy HUDs until you fire.
agents.story: Cunning flanker and sabotage expert who weaves chaos behind enemy lines. Cloak boosts stealth for her and her squad while revealing every enemy position on the map. Leo 2FK plays dead with Feign Death and ruins enemy accuracy with Electro-Optical Jammers. Leo 2K14 turns invisible with Active Camo and drops an EMP Trap that slows and chews HP.

agents.name: Gambit
agents.description: Deploys a drone swarm that boosts allies' shields and repair rate and grants immunity to status effects.
agents.trait_description: Damaging Gambit Jams the attacker. Closer hits Jam harder.
agents.story: Born to rebuild the terms of a fight, Gambit turns his allies' hulls, tracks, and shields into problems the enemy solves twice, and every hit that lands on him becomes a signal he traces straight back to its source. Where other Agents defend a position, Gambit defends the whole team, and makes attacking him a mistake in itself.
